title: JobStatus
description: Progress of one job, written by the helper and polled by the panel. 4K analysis takes minutes, so the panel needs something to show that is not a frozen button.

message.description: Human-readable; shown verbatim in the panel. The engine's own words, and English.

percent.description: How far through the run, 0-100. Weighted by the seconds of video each part has to decode, so it is a position and not a time estimate -- see engine/autoedit/progress.py. Absent while the helper is doing something it cannot weigh, such as downloading a reference.

step.description: Translation key for the stage, e.g. progress.scanShots. A key rather than a sentence because the panel is translated and its editor reads Japanese; `message` above is the one part that is not.

stepDetail.description: Substituted into `step`: a file name or a count, something that reads the same in either language.
